notes: B-106 (gate R5-14). Printed: 'Whenever one or more Cats you control deal combat damage to a player, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment that player controls.' The Sovereign and the Kitty (2/2 with the anthem) connect in the same combat damage step: all combat damage of a step is dealt at once (CR 510.2), and 'one or more' makes it one trigger for that player, however many Cats dealt damage (CR 603.2c). It destroys the Relic; the Charm stays. Seat 1 takes 2 + 2 (20 -> 16). Before the fix the ability triggered once per Cat, and the second trigger destroyed the Charm too.
